items.title: Deckers (DECK) Upgraded to Buy: Here's What You Should Know
items.summary: Deckers (DECK) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), reflecting growing optimism about the company's earnings prospects. This might drive the stock higher in the near term.

items.title: ANF Adds 130 Store Experiences: Can Retail Expansion Fuel Growth?
items.summary: Abercrombie & Fitch plans about 130 net new store experiences in FY26, blending openings, remodels and rightsizing to expand its physical retail footprint.

items.title: Can You Count On Lululemon's Cash?
items.summary: Lululemon Athletica (LULU) stock offers a free cash flow yield of 12.4%, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. Such a yield usually comes either from a business on sale or from one the market expects to shrink. So can you count on the cash behind Lululemon's yield.

items.title: Fall Fashion Is Looking Preppy and Cozy This Year. 2 Stocks That Benefit.
items.summary: Preppy styles from Ralph Lauren and cozy Ugg boots are back again, and the stocks should benefit.  Ralph Lauren  was a standout during the recently completed retail earnings season, with fiscal-first-quarter results coming in above expectations in nearly every metric.  Jefferies analyst Blake Anderson gives Ralph Lauren high marks for its fashion execution in a new note Tuesday, and names it his top pick in the industry.

items.title: Deckers Rides HOKA & UGG Momentum as Brand Demand Remains Strong
items.summary: DECK is building on HOKA and UGG momentum, with product newness, full-price demand and DTC gains supporting its fiscal 2027 growth outlook.
